title: Deterministic Blueprint Analysis Hardening
issue: Blueprint/code analysis was missing paths and contradictions, causing unreliable summaries
root_cause: Analysis depended on model inference instead of complete deterministic graph semantics
change: Added analyze_blueprint_graph/asset actions, strict contradiction gates, evidence validation, and report linting
result: Analysis now returns structured deterministic evidence and fails unsafe reports

title: Quick Play Menu Interaction Fix
issue: Menu rendered but Play button was not clickable in PIE
root_cause: Mixed UMG/Slate layering and input mode selection caused pointer focus routing failure
change: Switched to Slate-first overlay, used GameAndUI input mode, enabled click events, and blocked move/look input while menu is open
result: Menu is visible and interactable; Play click now exits menu and restores gameplay input
